daemon.description: Whether to run Conky as a background daemon (recommended for long-running displays).

update_interval.description: Time (in seconds) between updates of the display.

total_run_times.description: Total number of updates before exiting (0 = infinite loop).

use_x11.description: Use X11 for display (required on most Linux desktops).

use_wayland.description: Use Wayland display server (experimental, may require compositing support).

font.description: Default font used for text (e.g., 'Roboto Mono:size=12' or 'Fira Code:size=11').

show_graph_scale.description: Show numeric scale on graphs (e.g., min/max labels).

alignment.description: Where to position the Conky window on screen (top_left, top_right, bottom_left, bottom_right, top_middle, bottom_middle, middle_left, middle_right, or middle_middle).

gap_x.description: Horizontal gap (in pixels) between screen edge and Conky window.

gap_y.description: Vertical gap (in pixels) between screen edge and Conky window.

minimum_width.description: Minimum width of the Conky window (0 = no minimum).

minimum_height.description: Minimum height of the Conky window (0 = no minimum).

maximum_width.description: Maximum width of the Conky window (0 = unlimited).

maximum_height.description: Maximum height of the Conky window (0 = unlimited).

draw_outline.description: Draw outline around the entire Conky window.

draw_window_borders.description: Draw borders around the Conky window.

border_width.description: Thickness of borders and outlines in pixels.

border_margin.description: Margin (in pixels) around the Conky window for border drawing.

border_inner_margin.description: Inner margin (in pixels) for nested borders.

background.description: Background color for the Conky window (hex format, e.g., '222222', 'FFFFFF', or named like 'white').

text_shadow_color.description: Color used for text shadows (typically dark).

graph_filled.description: Fill graphs with color (true) or just draw outline (false).

bar_fill.description: Color used to fill bar graphs (e.g., CPU usage).

bar_outline.description: Color of the outline around bar graphs.

bevel_color.description: Color used for beveled edges on borders/boxes.

bevel_width.description: Width (in pixels) of bevels on boxes.

use_title_bar.description: Show a title bar above the Conky window.

title_text.description: Text to display in the title bar.

title_bar_bg_color.description: Background color of the title bar.

title_bar_border_color.description: Border color of the title bar.

title_bar_height.description: Height (in pixels) of the title bar.

own_window.description: Create a dedicated window for Conky (recommended).

own_window_type.description: Type of window (desktop, dock, panel, normal, override).

own_window_class.description: WM_CLASS for the window (used for window management).

own_window_hints.description: Window hints (comma-separated) to control visibility and stacking.

own_window_argb.description: Enable ARGB visual for per-pixel alpha (e.g., 50% opacity).

own_window_argb_value.description: Alpha value for ARGB (0–255); lower = more transparent.

override_utf8_locale.description: Force UTF-8 locale (helps with non-ASCII characters).

lua_load.description: Path to Lua script to load (e.g., '~/.config/conky/scripts/graph.lua').

lua_draw_function_prefix.description: Prefix for Lua draw functions in the script.

separator_char.description: Character used to separate sections (e.g., '|', '-', or space).

use_spacer.description: Insert spacers around text (none, left, right, or both) to align columns.

no_buffers.description: Disable disk buffer usage (improves accuracy for disk stats).

int_sample.description: Round integer values (e.g., CPU percentage) to whole numbers.

twenty_four_hour_clock.description: Use 24-hour time format instead of AM/PM.

extra_newline.description: Add a trailing newline at the end of the output (useful for some scripts).

lua_font.description: Font to use for Lua-drawn text (overrides default).

lua_code_cache.description: Cache compiled Lua code for faster reloading.

custom_vars.description: List of user-defined variable definitions for advanced customization or Lua templates.

value.description: Value (raw string; quotes will be added if needed)

sections.description: List of Conky sections defining content blocks (e.g., CPU, memory, network). Each section has a name (like 'text'), and a list of lines.

description.description: Optional description for the section header

body_lines.description: List of config lines inside the section (may include Conky variables like ${cpu cpu0}, ${fs_used /}, etc.)
